{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_ads_vp_threshold", "thread_id": "t_ads_vp", "from_": "vp-demand-gen@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing@company.example.com"], "subject": "Google Ads pause threshold update - acc_1", "date": "2026-01-28T07:00:00Z", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": false}
消息 ID：msg_ads_vp_threshold
来源：vp-demand-gen@company.example.com
收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-28T07:00:00Z
主题：Google Ads pause threshold update - acc_1
Team,

We're raising the CTR pause threshold for acc_1 campaigns from 1.2% to 1.5%. Campaigns in acc_1 with CTR below 1.5% should be paused.
The impression minimum and notes-based exceptions in the Ad Policies sheet still apply.

- VP Demand Gen"}
